units.content: CI matrix runs Python 3.11 and 3.12, installs the package, executes the unit-test suite, runs the deterministic smoke benchmark, and asserts the smoke authority boundary.

Workflow assertions require status=engineering_only, evidence_bearing=false, generator_scope.evidence_ready=false, and validity.all_passed=true; green CI is therefore explicitly non-scientific for the built-in source.
Zenodo-style metadata identifies MAGIKARP v0.1 as a deterministic synthetic benchmark release and records archive-facing title/version/description metadata.
Archive metadata states the built-in generator is L0 engineering-only and does not establish the scientific hypothesis, representation invention, CRE, causality, or general intelligence.
Coding agents are instructed to preserve the engineering freeze, frozen scientific contract, and diagnosis-to-revision-to-outcome separation rather than expand theory.
The built-in deterministic generator is irreducibly L0; metadata, wrappers, seed variation, or attestation cannot promote it to evidence-bearing status.
Representation invention, CRE, escape topology, authority capture, transformation topology, CARP, and recursive improvement are not load-bearing v0.1 implementation objects.
After engineering freeze, the next scientific objective is a genuinely independent L2 or L3 source; more built-in benchmark polish is explicitly not the next gate.

Prospective L2 generator authors should receive the restricted independent-generator brief and avoid implementation, tests, built-in equations, prior outcomes, failed evidence runs, and internal target-tuning history where possible.

The preferred order is independent source first, minimum source-specific adapter second; generic plugin infrastructure before source acquisition is discouraged because it can manufacture the relationship under test.
A valid null must be retained, an invalid run licenses no empirical claim, and changes to scientific definitions require versioning rather than silent continuation under v0.1.
Evidence-bearing execution is governed by a frozen protocol distinct from ordinary engineering execution.
evidence_bearing requires evidence intent, evidence readiness, valid independent attestation, frozen conditions, all validity gates, and final status in {valid_positive, valid_negative}.
Unknown, missing, inconsistent, or unverifiable provenance/eligibility values force evidence_ready=false and evidence_bearing=false.

L0 built-in/derivative sources are engineering-only, L1 internally authored sources support robustness at most, L2 independently authored synthetic sources can support bounded synthetic evidence, and L3 external/natural sources can support cross-source predictive evidence within scope.

Independent attestation must be separate and pre-outcome, but software validation can establish schema/hash binding only; social independence, control independence, and locator immutability require external governance.
Top-level evidence outcomes are valid_positive, valid_negative, benchmark_invalid, or engineering_only; per-failure heterogeneity is not a third scientific evidence status.
A valid null is retained scientific evidence and must not be tuned away; failed validity/provenance/freeze conditions are benchmark_invalid rather than scientific negatives.
Outcome-driven changes to generation, measurement, exclusion, grouping, stopping, analysis, or claims are material scientific changes and require a new version rather than same-version repair.
The 2026-08-08 package freezes the v0.1 scientific/engineering state and records snapshot base commit 57d3c526ee930a525f0dff39c162aa2c68863abb without itself making any run evidence-bearing.
At freeze: built-in generator=L0; qualifying L2 generators=0; qualifying L3 generators=0; evidence-bearing runs=0; empirical positive claim=false; empirical negative claim=false.
The current runner is still bound to the built-in generator; external-source schema/eligibility machinery exists but no executable independent-source adapter exists yet.
The depth-aware supplied controller consumes q_SD directly and the built-in target mechanism can manufacture a relationship, so built-in predictive output cannot earn scientific authority.
The scarce next resource is independent evidence provenance, not additional theory or synthetic-loop optimization.
MAGIKARP v0.1 asks whether prospective representation self-diagnosis adds held-out predictive information about adaptation beyond Q, A, and E under a bounded supplied correction architecture.
Primary comparison is M0: R_c ~ Q + A + E versus M1: R_c ~ Q + A + E + SD; the claim type is predictive rather than causal.
A deterministic built-in benchmark, validity gates, provenance/manifest/attestation machinery, and engineering smoke execution are implemented.
No qualifying L2/L3 evidence source and no evidence-bearing v0.1 run currently exist; consequently no empirical positive or valid scientific negative has been earned.

Built-in smoke execution and generator-family bucket variation are engineering evidence only; reproducibility is not structural independence and supplied interface expansion is not representation invention.
v0.1 does not establish causation, representation invention, CRE, open-ended correctability, recursive improvement, or general intelligence.
Application lenses such as seven-sins and music taxonomies are illustrative mappings only and are explicitly non-load-bearing for v0.1 evidence.

The archived initial Codex brief documents the original target of a minimal falsifiable synthetic benchmark with three failure depths, matched agents, M0/M1 analysis, leakage controls, and negative-result preservation; it is historical rather than current authority.
An informal external/Grok assessment is retained as context, explicitly not independent scientific validation; its possibility-versus-authority observation has no independent warrant effect.
